structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. The site lists names but gives no interest rates and says nothing about fees, so I can't tell if anything beats my deposit. The only safe-sounding things I understood were government bonds (אג"ח ממשלתיות) and the מק"מ from the Bank of Israel, and I'll ask my son or the bank what they pay compared to my פיקדון.

English letters and share indexes. I felt it wasn't for me and got tired.
'ולרוב משלמת גם ריבית': 'usually' made me unsure whether it is really safe.
